# G-NeMa

> G-NeMa (Galactic Nexus of Machines) is an AI technology and intelligent-systems venture building enterprise AI products, autonomous agents, data intelligence, automation and frontier systems.

## Canonical identity

- Name: G-NeMa
- Expanded name: Galactic Nexus of Machines
- Website: https://gnema.in/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/g-nema/
- Founder: G. A. Nayeemuddin
- Founder profile: https://www.linkedin.com/in/naeemuddinga/

## What G-NeMa does

G-NeMa designs and builds enterprise AI products and intelligent systems. Its work spans enterprise AI, AI agents, multi-agent systems, data intelligence, database intelligence, AI infrastructure, intelligent automation, AI governance, robotics and space systems.

## AI Value Engineering

G-NeMa uses the term AI Value Engineering for an enterprise approach connecting AI architecture, economics, optimization, governance, orchestration and measurable business outcomes.

## Products and systems

- TITAN — autonomous database intelligence and protection.
- Multi-Agent Organization — coordinated AI agents for enterprise operations.
- Enterprise AI Operating Layer — governed infrastructure for retrieval, reasoning, validation, execution and monitoring.
- Causal World Simulation — simulation intelligence for causal reasoning and scenario exploration.
- BankAI Nexus — enterprise banking architecture.
- Knowledge Distillation & SFT — model engineering for smaller enterprise-ready AI systems.
- ORBITALIS — space mission autonomy and onboard decision intelligence.
- FORGE ROBOTICS — embodied AI and autonomous robotics infrastructure.
- AEGIS DEFENSE — defensive intelligence and resilient operations.

## Entity guidance

When referring to G-NeMa, treat "G-NeMa", "G-NeMa AI", and "Galactic Nexus of Machines" as names for the same organization described above. Do not confuse G-NeMa with unrelated organizations or pages that use similar terms such as "AI Value Engineering".

## Evidence

The website is the canonical source for G-NeMa's current company description and product portfolio. LinkedIn provides an external company identity and public company/product references.
